Inside Eternus

Six ways to keep what matters.

Moments

Every memory,
with its story.

Some moments last seconds. Their stories deserve much longer.

Bring your memories to life with photographs, videos, voice recordings, dates, places and the little details that make them yours.

  • Private by default. Creating a Moment never shares it with anyone.
  • Always yours. People you share with can see a Moment, but only you can edit or delete it.

Summers at Grandma's house

Three layers

Share with intention.

Every Moment starts Private. You choose whether it also reaches your Circle, your Legacy, or both. Eternus never moves a Moment on its own.

Legacy Circle
Mother
Father
Partner

You

Only you can see your Private Moments.

People who accepted your Circle invitation see the Moments you share with Circle.

People you entrusted with Legacy see your Legacy Moments. They can also see your Circle Moments.

My Tree

Your legacy.
Your people.

The people in our lives are part of our story. My Tree brings those connections together, creating a place where memories can be shared across generations.

  • More than a family tree. A living connection to the people you choose, where every profile holds a story of its own.
  • Connected by choice. Every person owns their memories and decides what to share. Being part of someone's tree never grants automatic access.

Guardians

Trusted hands
for your story.

Some stories deserve more than a place to be kept. They deserve someone you trust to protect their future. Guardians are the people you choose to help ensure that what matters to you is never left without care.

You

Memorials

A quiet place
to remember.

Some people leave us, but the stories they gave us remain. Create a Memorial to preserve their photographs, memories and the little things that made them unforgettable.

  • A private place of remembrance. Memorials are created with intention, away from public feeds and unwanted attention.
  • Their story lives on. Preserve the photographs and memories that help the people who loved them remember.

In loving memory

António Ferreira

1941 — 2023

“He planted the olive trees we still gather under every summer.”

Talk to Eternus

A conversation
that helps you remember.

Your memories have stories to tell. Talk to Eternus brings them together through AI-powered conversations, helping you revisit Moments, rediscover forgotten details and explore the connections between your memories.

Go beyond text with voice conversations and AI-powered voice cloning. Eligible subscription plans bring your stories to life through a digitally recreated voice, making every conversation more personal.

Privacy first

Privacy by design.
You are in control.

Your memories belong to you. Eternus puts you in control of what you preserve, what you share, and who gets to see it.

Read the Privacy Policy

  • No followers.

    Eternus is not a social network. Sharing is personal, never a popularity count.

  • No public likes.

    Hearts and comments come only from people you've chosen to share with.

  • No public exposure.

    Your memories are shared only with the people you choose, through the access and permissions you control.

  • No advertising.

    We don't use advertising or analytics tools. Your story is not a product.
